title: MPESB MP Police ASI / HC Computer Practical Exam PET Admit Card 2026
postName: Assistant Sub Inspector (ASI) (Computer) / Head Constable (Computer) – Practical Exam / PET 2026
vacancyDetails: ASI (Computer) and Head Constable (Computer) recruitment practical exam / PET admit card for MP Police headquarters, Home (Police) 2026
qualification: Bachelor / Master degree in Computer or Information Technology for ASI; 10+2 with PCM and one-year computer diploma / polytechnic diploma for Head Constable, as per MPESB notification
ageLimit: 18 to 33 years as on 19/02/2026; age relaxation as per MPESB rules
applicationFee: General / Other State: ₹560; OBC / SC / ST: ₹310; portal charges included as applicable
selectionProcess: Written Exam → Practical Exam / PET / Skill Test → Final Selection as per MPESB rules
documentsRequired: Application number, password or DOB, admit card printout, valid photo ID, and other required documents as per the official call letter
howToApply:
1. Visit https://esb.mp.gov.in
2. Open the practical exam / PET admit card section
3. Login with registration credentials
4. Download the ASI / HC Computer admit card
5. Print and verify exam date, centre, reporting time, and instruction sheet
shortDescription: MPESB has released the practical exam / PET admit card for ASI (Computer) and Head Constable (Computer) 2026. Download the hall ticket from the official MPESB portal.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the Practical Exam / PET Admit Card 2026 for Assistant Sub Inspector (ASI) (Computer) and Head Constable (Computer) recruitment under MP Police, Home (Police).

Candidates who have cleared earlier stages can now download the practical exam admit card from the official portal and check the allotted centre, date, reporting time and instructions. The practical exam is an important stage before final selection.

According to the release, the admit card was made available on 09 September 2026. Candidates should log in using their application details and print the hall ticket well in advance to avoid last-minute issues.
